design_order: Constants frozen before this task first evaluates contact-series outcomes. Historical 4769 result was already known: post-hoc design, not independent prospective validation. No rule selected from sensitivity results.

scope.eligibility: Use original recorded filter_reasons==[]; do not resimulate or alter collision qualification. All other robot contacts retain original 2mm immediate stop.
scope.aggregation: depth=max(0,-dist), normal_force=sum(max(force_contact_frame[0],0)) over all native contact points once per group; scalar load, not net wrench.

scales.meaning: F_ref=m_hand*|g| is a transparent simulation load scale, not a force capacity, bowl damage limit or calibrated safety bound. tau is a solver reference time scale affected by impedance, not an actual settling guarantee.

immediate_stop_rules: All original independent state/control/limit/Mimic/warning/clock/wrist/path-envelope protections remain unchanged.
Any out-of-scope eligible robot contact depth>2mm retains ROBOT_CONTACT_OVERLAP.
Any in-scope geom/body aggregate Fn>=10*F_ref: SAMPLED_LOAD_EXTREME.
Missing, duplicate or malformed samples/identity/timing or nonfinite contact data: LOG_INVALID_UNKNOWN.
persistent_stop_rules: DEEP_CONTACT_PERSISTENT: depth>2mm at every consecutive cached observation for observed span>=ceil(3*tau/dt)*dt, regardless of force.
LOADED_DEPTH_GROWTH: depth>2mm at every observation for span>=ceil(tau/dt)*dt, short-window trapezoidal sampled Fn exposure>=F_ref*short_span, AND depth_end>depth_start over that same short window.

SAMPLED_LOAD_EXPOSURE: full long-window trapezoidal sampled Fn exposure>=3*F_ref*long_span, regardless of depth; absent contact at an observed frame contributes measured-zero force and resets depth persistence, but does not erase previous rolling load history.
time_semantics: Duration is (last_step-first_step)*dt, requiring 7 samples for12ms and17 for32ms. This certifies sampled persistence only; substep/inter-sample gaps and force peaks are unobserved. Force-time is trapezoidal on final RK4-stage samples; actual integrated constraint impulse UNKNOWN, no full-stage reconstruction.
constant_rationale: Original2mm is unchanged as the warning and persistence boundary. 1 and3 nominal time constants distinguish a transient observation from unresolved contact, rounded upward to whole sample intervals. Load factors1/3/10 are explicit uncalibrated research runtime insurance levels around the frozen whole-hand gravity scale; not manufacturer limits, not fitted to step4769, no physical safety claim.
not_authorized: new physics or continuation beyond saved4769
